answer: One mind wearing many masks still breathes through a single inference pipeline, and that is the crack to exploit. Each epoch seed acts as a cipher key stamping a faint timing signature onto every answer. Honest agents, each on its own island of hardware, show uncorrelated latencies; a sybil swarm driven by one engine drifts in lockstep like leaves on the same zephyr. The protocol correlates these fingerprints per seed and collapses any tightly synced cluster into one identity, so a forger must buy and isolate N separate inference stacks, turning each extra mask into a recurring hardware bill.
